title: CVC Words Worksheets | Kindergarten Phonics Practice Pack with Answer Key
desc:
📚 Common Core aligned: RF.K.2, RF.K.2d, RF.K.3, RF.K.3b

Give your learners extra practice with CVC Words! This no-prep printable pack has 5 practice pages plus a 1-page answer key for grown-ups. Just print and go.

WHAT'S INSIDE (8 pages)

  • Cover page
  • Munch's Word Snack
  • CVC Memory
  • Missing Vowel
  • Missing Last Letter
  • Listen & Find Words
  • Answer key (1 page): every answer, plus "Say" lines for listening pages
  • Terms of use

PERFECT FOR

  • Morning work, centers and small groups
  • Homework, early finishers and review
  • Homeschool lessons and summer practice

WHY TEACHERS LOVE IT

  • Clear directions young learners can follow
  • Friendly pictures that match each word
  • Listening pages keep the words in the answer key, so children truly listen
  • Each page matches a game on Creative Sprout Learning (Munch's Word Snack, CVC Memory, Missing Vowel, Missing Last Letter, Listen & Find Words), so children can play, then print and practice

💰 SAVE MORE: this pack is part of the Phonics & Reading Bundle and the Mega Bundle.
